'''Star Tours Flight 324''' was the designation of a [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel agency flight to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] just before a [[Raid at Spaceport THX1138|raid at the Star Tours space station]]. It was on time and set to leave the spaceport's Gate 1E at 1045 hours.
